arguments.Code: using UnityEngine;using UnityEngine.UI;using System.Reflection;using InhaExpress.Client.Presentation;internal class CommandScript:IRunCommand{public void Execute(ExecutionResult result){var h=Object.FindFirstObjectByType<WebClientHud>();if(h==null)throw new System.Exception("HUD missing");var flags=BindingFlags.NonPublic|BindingFlags.Instance;var type=typeof(WebClientHud);var a=type.GetField("batteryIndicators",flags);var b=type.GetField("batteryLabels",flags);var next=type.GetField("nextRefresh",flags);var update=type.GetMethod("Update",flags);var oldA=a.GetValue(h);var oldB=b.GetValue(h);result.Log("battery="+((Slider[])oldA).Length+" labels="+((Text[])oldB).Length);try{a.SetValue(h,new Slider[0]);b.SetValue(h,new Text[0]);next.SetValue(h,0f);update.Invoke(h,null);result.Log("empty arrays PASS");a.SetValue(h,new Slider[1]);b.SetValue(h,null);next.SetValue(h,0f);update.Invoke(h,null);result.Log("short/null arrays PASS");}finally{a.SetValue(h,oldA);b.SetValue(h,oldB);next.SetValue(h,0f);}update.Invoke(h,null);foreach(var t in (Text[])oldB)result.Log("battery label="+t.text);}}
